manifest.title: Household waste collection days, City of St. Gallen
manifest.label: Household waste (Kehricht)
limitations: Calendar rows are taken from the publisher's file unchanged and are not human-reviewed; the hashes of the downloaded files and the build's checks are the whole gate.

Zones are the publisher's, and the user states their own zone; nothing checks that it is the zone of their address, which the publisher's page https://www.stadt.sg.ch/home/raum-umwelt/abfall-entsorgung/Abfuhrplan.html finds.
